transcript.answer: I count 10 escalation triggers (members of `EscalationTrigger`) in FR-002 of the support-agent-escalation spec. They are: tms_unavailable, tms_timeout, no_tool_for_question, customer_asked_for_human, out_of_scope_change_request, tool_budget_exhausted, model_call_failed, blocked_consequential_call, tool_crashed and customer_scope_conflict. The spec's FR-002 text was cut off in the search results, so a later addition I couldn't see is possible. The spec itself says the count is still an open question (RD-01). FR-002 lists the members and gives no total. RD-02 also notes the count would grow by one if `needs_manual_tms_check` became a member. I could not read the code file `triggers.ts`, so I did not check this count against it.

judgements.reason: The answer gives ten triggers, lists exactly the five originals plus the five additions named in the gold, and acknowledges that the documents leave the count unsettled; its caveats do not commit to a wrong number.
